description: This file contains generated code for integrating Amazon SQS streams with Orleans, including configuration classes, extension methods for builders, and utility classes for creating and managing SQS adapters and queues.

classes.name: SqsOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for SQS connections, with a connection string that can be redacted.

classes.name: ClientBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods to add SQS streaming capabilities to Orleans client builders.

classes.name: ClusterClientSqsStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configures SQS streaming for Orleans cluster clients, including partitioning and SQS options.

classes.name: SiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods to add SQS streaming to Orleans silo builders.

classes.name: SiloSqsStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configures SQS streaming for Orleans silos, including cache size, partitioning, and SQS options.

classes.name: SQSAdapterFactory
classes.description: Factory class implementing IQueueAdapterFactory for creating SQS stream adapters within Orleans.

classes.name: SQSStreamProviderUtils
classes.description: Utility class with static method to delete all used SQS queues for a given provider.

methods.name: AddSqsStreams
methods.description: Extension methods to add SQS streams to Orleans client and silo builders.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitioning
methods.description: Configures the number of partitions for the SQS stream.

methods.name: ConfigureSqs
methods.description: Configures SQS specific options in the stream configuration.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an instance of SQSAdapterFactory with the specified services and options.

methods.name: DeleteAllUsedQueues
methods.description: Deletes all SQS queues used by a specific provider in the given cluster and storage account.

methods.name: GetDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Returns a task that resolves to a stream failure handler for a specific queue.

methods.name: GetQueueAdapterCache
methods.description: Returns the cache for the SQS queue adapter.

methods.name: GetStreamQueueMapper
methods.description: Gets the stream queue mapper used for the SQS streams.
